Desktop & Compose Text

Small screen.
Real Mac work.

Check a document, click through an app, or finish that thought. Built-in macOS Screen Sharing brings your desktop to you, with the controls a Mac expects.

  • Find your view. Pinch to zoom, pan around, or choose a display when your Mac supplies its layout.
  • Type comfortably. Draft with native Compose Text, then send it to the Mac’s focused field.
  • Keep keys close. Command, Option, Control, Shift, Escape, and Tab are right above the keyboard.

Desktop and input travel through an encrypted SSH connection.

The Mac half is already there.

No helper.
Just your Mac.

Connect to the services built into macOS. There’s no Mac Companion server or helper to install.

  1. 01

    Enable sharing.

    In System Settings → General → Sharing, enable Remote Login. Enable Screen Sharing for Desktop and Trackpad & Keyboard, too.

  2. 02

    Add your Mac.

    Save its local or private VPN address. Keep multiple addresses for the same Mac, in the order you prefer.

  3. 03

    Make the connection.

    Verify your Mac’s SSH fingerprint and sign in with your Mac account. Choose Desktop, Terminal, Trackpad & Keyboard, or Files.

Use a trusted local network, or your own private VPN such as Tailscale on both devices. Mac Companion doesn’t provide a VPN or public relay. Follow the setup guide ↗

Before you connect.

A few clear
answers.

The essentials, right here. For setup details and troubleshooting, visit Support.

Is one Mac really free forever?

Yes. The free plan includes one saved Mac, Desktop, Trackpad & Keyboard, basic SSH Terminal, and Files over SFTP, with no time limit. You don’t need to start a Pro trial. After a trial ends, the free features remain available.

What does Lifetime Pro add?

Pro adds multiple saved Macs and named SSH keys, SSH key installation, custom remote quick actions, custom Terminal key rows, and saved text snippets. The planned U.S. price is $9.99 once, with no subscription. You can choose a 14-day Pro trial that doesn’t renew or charge automatically.

Do I need to install anything on my Mac?

No Mac Companion app or helper. Enable built-in Remote Login for every mode, and Screen Sharing for Desktop and Trackpad & Keyboard. Sign in with your Mac account. See the setup steps.

Can I use it away from home?

Yes, when your device can reach your awake Mac through a private VPN such as Tailscale. Mac Companion doesn’t supply a VPN or relay. Don’t expose Screen Sharing directly to the internet. Set up your connection.

How does iPhone Duo support work?

Book places desktop or Terminal content beside the input controls. Tabletop separates content and input around the active fold. Compose Text keeps its draft and editing controls in an available pane as the layout changes. More about device layouts.

Which devices and Mac services do I need?

The app requires iOS or iPadOS 26 or later and an awake, reachable Mac with an account you can use. Desktop and Trackpad & Keyboard need Remote Login and Screen Sharing; Terminal and Files need Remote Login. Mac compatibility remains under testing. Compatibility and availability.

Are my connection and credentials protected?

Desktop, input, Terminal, and Files use SSH. Verify the Mac’s server fingerprint before trusting it. Saved passwords and SSH private keys stay in this device’s Keychain. Optional app unlock adds device-owner authentication. Read the privacy details.

Can I upload and download files?

Yes. Files uses SFTP to browse folders and transfer individual files. It’s included in Free. Folder transfers are not supported. See the Files guide.

What syncs with iCloud?

Only if you opt in, saved Mac names, addresses, ports, and supported display/input settings sync through iCloud Keychain. Passwords, SSH private keys, server trust, and saved text stay local. Sync is off by default. See exactly what syncs.

Where can I download Mac Companion?

Mac Companion is currently in TestFlight testing. App Store downloads and paid purchases are not yet available. Invited testers can install it through TestFlight. Check availability.
